_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. The real config.json is gitignored: it holds the Claude API key, the mailbox passwords, and staff password hashes. Keep this file ASCII-only (load_config reads it with the Windows default cp1252 encoding).
_mail_accounts_comment: Mailboxes email intake polls (edit in Settings). protocol imap|pop3. Polling is read-only: never marks read, moves, or deletes. lookback_days = how far back to look; keep small for a newly added mailbox whose history was already ingested elsewhere (dedup by Message-ID skips repeats either way). Old-style gmail_user/gmail_app_password keys are auto-migrated into this list at startup.
_auto_confirm_comment: off | known-vendors | aggressive. Missing key = known-vendors. See Settings page.
_scanflow_comment: Scan-straight-in (see SCANNER_DESIGN.md). archive_folder = the human filing tree the File-as panel suggests into; app_url + connector_token are read by scan_connector.py on each workstation (any long random string; must match what the server checks).
_night_shift_comment: Dev API for unattended night-shift sessions (VALIDATION_WORKFLOW.md + DESIGN.md sec 8): lets them add issue-report dev notes and set In progress / Dev-resolved through the running app -- never Verified, never intake.db directly. Any long random string, DISTINCT from connector_token; leave blank/absent to turn the API off.
_cabinet_comment: Live cabinet watcher + folder browser (2026-07-29). ALL OPTIONAL with sensible defaults. pickup_roots: trees watched for hand-filed documents (default: archive_folder + filed_folder). pickup_exts: watched extensions (default ['.pdf']). cabinet_root / cabinet_exclude: the whole-file-server move-anywhere policy (defaults: F:\File-Cabinet minus IntakeSystem and _OPS INDEX). server_root + server_root_unc: how staff-facing paths are rewritten to UNC. scan_copy_mirrors: MACHINE-NAME -> staff name; that desk's connector mirrors the staff member's Scan Archive down to its Desktop\SCANS folder.
